offering_description.value: Places commercial insurance and advises employers on risk and employee benefits. It arranges personal insurance for households and develops specialty insurance programs with carriers, distributing them through retail agencies and affinity partners.

primary_products.value: Commercial property and casualty policies; employer group benefits plans; specialty insurance policies; homeowners and auto policies

primary_services.value: Commercial insurance brokerage; risk management consulting; employee benefits consulting; delegated underwriting and program administration; personal insurance brokerage

customer_segment.value: B2B: Middle-market and large companies, small businesses, employers, insurance carriers, and independent agencies; B2C: Homebuyers, homeowners, and individuals buying auto or other personal coverage

end_markets.value: Commercial risk and insurance; employer benefits; specialty insurance; personal insurance; residential homebuilding

revenue_model.value: commissions or management fees: Carrier commissions on placed policies and compensation for underwriting and administering insurance programs; service fees: Client fees for brokerage, risk management, and benefits advisory services
revenue_model.category: commissions or management fees; service fees

value_chain_position.value: financial intermediary: Places carrier coverage for businesses, employers, households, and retail agencies; service provider: Uses client risk and benefits data to advise employers and carrier capacity to administer specialty programs

specialization.value: related lines: Commercial risk, employee benefits, specialty insurance programs, and personal insurance

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Commercial and benefits advisers serving employers and business accounts; agents / brokers: Retail insurance agencies placing specialty coverage through wholesale and program teams; own locations: Local insurance offices serving households and small businesses; partners / resellers: Homebuilders and mortgage partners connecting homebuyers with insurance
distribution_channels.category: direct sales; agents / brokers; own locations; partners / resellers

regulatory_exposure.value: high: State insurance departments license producers and regulate brokerage, surplus lines placement, and managing general agency activities.

notes: The extent of direct operations outside the United States is uncertain.
